answer_1.quote: In this paper, we target in-context learning (ICL) for QA tasks including multiple-choice QA and open-ended QA from different domains.
answer_1.outputs: Answers to questions (multiple-choice options or open-ended text)

answer_2.quote: For multi-choice QA, we use accuracy for evaluation. For open-ended QA, we use Normalized Exact Match (NEM), which evaluates whether the normalized string output by the inference LLM is identical to the reference string.
